entry.title: Accuracy of Advertising and Notice of Insured Status (NCUA credit union advertising rule)
entry.summary: Accuracy of Advertising and Notice of Insured Status Federal Register · Nov 16, 2026 · Rule · Effective Dec 16, 2026The National Credit Union Administration issued a final rule streamlining its regulations on advertising and notice of insured status. It removes provisions concerning the official advertising statement to reduce administrative burden and give federally insured credit unions more flexibility. The rule does not amend requirements for displaying the official sign and takes effect December 16, 2026. The archived text and attachments run to about 36,695 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. Check the original.

entry.title: Speech by CSRC Chairman Wu Qing at the Opening of the First China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference
entry.summary: 吴清主席在首届中国资本市场学术年会开幕式上的致辞 中国证监会 · Nov 14, 2026 · SpeechChina Securities Regulatory Commission Chairman Wu Qing gave this speech at the opening of the first China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference. He reviews the development of China's capital market over 36 years, including legal frameworks, the multi-tiered market system, financing structure and opening-up. The speech also discusses opportunities and challenges posed by global governance shifts, technological revolution and Chinese-style modernization, and proposes several research topics and three suggestions for strengthening capital market research.

entry.title: CFTC sues Louisiana over state court order shutting down CFTC-regulated exchanges
entry.summary: CFTC Sues Louisiana After State Court Blocks CFTC-Regulated Exchanges CFTC · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementThe Commodity Futures Trading Commission sued Louisiana to block the state from banning event contracts offered by CFTC-regulated exchanges, clearing organizations and futures commission merchants. A state court had ordered more than 30 companies in the state to stop operating without notice or a chance to be heard. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said event contracts have traded openly in Louisiana for years and that the suit seeks to preserve the status quo while federal courts decide the issue.

entry.title: IRS names 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee
entry.summary: IRS appoints 10 new members to Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee IRS · Nov 13, 2026 · PersonnelThe IRS announced the appointment of 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee (ETAAC). Established by statute in 1998, the committee is a public forum for discussing electronic tax administration issues. Its members include state tax officials, cybersecurity experts, tax professionals, software developers, and representatives from payroll, financial, and consumer groups.

entry.title: IRS fiscal 2026 results: record tax collections, faster refunds and expanded digital services
entry.summary: IRS achieved historic performance in 2026 for American taxpayers, efficiently delivering new tax benefits to working families IRS · Oct 29, 2026 · ReportThe IRS announced its fiscal year 2026 results, reporting record tax collections of $5.6 trillion, up nearly 5 percent from the previous year. Total refunds and average refunds both increased, with about 90 percent of electronic filers receiving refunds in less than 21 days. The release also covers growth in digital service use, about $38 billion in revenue protected from identity theft refund fraud, and progress on Trump Accounts for children. Correction Nov 14, 2026: Publication date changed from Oct 30, 2026 to Oct 29, 2026

entry.title: CFTC sues Arkansas to defend federal jurisdiction over prediction markets
entry.summary: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets CFTC · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementOn November 13, 2026, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) announced a lawsuit against Arkansas to block the state's effort to halt event-contract trading and impose civil penalties on CFTC-registered exchanges. The CFTC says Arkansas's civil enforcement action against Kalshi in state court is preempted by federal law. Chairman Michael S. Selig said the agency will keep defending its sole jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. Arkansas is the 11th state the CFTC has sued.

entry.title: SEC proposes reforms to executive and director pay disclosure rules
entry.summary: SEC Proposes Executive and Director Compensation Disclosure Reforms SEC · Nov 14, 2026 · Draft / consultationOn November 13, 2026, the SEC proposed amendments to Item 402 of Regulation S-K to make executive and director compensation disclosure more principles-based and materiality-driven. The proposal would focus named executive officer disclosure on the principal executive and financial officers, replace four tables with three new ones, raise the perquisites reporting threshold to $150,000, and simplify pay-versus-performance and pay ratio requirements. Public comments are accepted for 60 days after Federal Register publication. The archived text and attachments run to about 1,207,539 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. Check the original.

entry.title: National Bureau of Statistics Sends 2026 Routine Statistical Inspection Feedback to China Securities Regulatory Commission
entry.summary: 国家统计局2026年常规统计督察第9统计督察组向中国证监会反馈统计督察意见 中国证监会 · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementOn November 11, the National Bureau of Statistics gave the China Securities Regulatory Commission feedback from its 2026 routine statistical inspection. The inspection found shortcomings in implementing statistical policy decisions, fulfilling statutory statistical duties, data quality control, and grassroots statistical infrastructure. The CSRC must rectify these issues, report progress to the bureau within three months, and make it public as required. The CSRC said it accepts the feedback in full and will rectify firmly.

The consultation proposes updating cross-references in the Basel Framework and moving some Application guidance into the consolidated guidelines. Comments are due in English by 21 December.

entry.title: FCA proposes exempting performance fees from workplace pension default fund charge cap
entry.summary: FCA proposes greater pension investment flexibility to support long-term value for savers FCA · Nov 12, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe FCA is consulting on excluding certain performance-linked fees from the charge cap for default funds in workplace pensions, giving providers more flexibility to invest in private markets for long-term returns. The proposals include safeguards on transparency, fair allocation of fees between savers, and scrutiny of how private assets are valued. The consultation closes on 14 January 2027, and the FCA expects to make final rules in summer 2027.

entry.title: SFC and HKMA hold industry seminar on tokenisation ecosystem opportunities
entry.summary: SFC and HKMA hosted industry seminar on opportunities in Hong Kong’s fast-evolving tokenisation ecosystem SFC · Nov 12, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Discussion topics included tokenisation-enabled opportunities in secondary trading and corporate treasury management, and ecosystem development that accelerates broader adoption in tokenised money and」 The SFC and HKMA jointly hosted a seminar attended by more than 200 financial sector stakeholders to discuss the development of Hong Kong's tokenisation ecosystem. Topics included opportunities in secondary trading and corporate treasury management, and use cases for broader adoption of tokenised money and tokenised investment products. The seminar followed the launch of round-the-clock secondary trading of tokenised public funds on a licensed virtual asset trading platform and Ensemble TX's support for 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposits.

entry.title: Trial date set for alleged failure to comply with SFC notices in market manipulation probes

The criminal trial is scheduled to begin on 26 April 2027 at the Eastern Magistrates' Court. The notices relate to two ongoing market manipulation investigations.

Banks and industry pioneers shared practical tokenisation experience. The regulators said they will keep working to broaden commercial uses of tokenised deposits in settling various tokenised investment products.

entry.title: ADGM Warns of Unauthorised Use of Its Academy Name in Investment and Trading Schemes
entry.summary: ADGM Issues Alert Concerning Misuse of the ADGM Academy Name in Investment and Trading Activities ADGM / FSRA · Nov 9, 2026 · GuidanceThe ADGM Registration Authority has issued an alert that third-party websites and individuals are using the ADGM Academy name, logo and branding without authorisation to offer investment opportunities and trading services. The ADGM Academy is not licensed to offer investment opportunities, provide trading services or collect funds from the public. The public is advised to independently verify any claimed association, especially where payments or personal or financial information are requested, and particularly where funds are sought to be transferred to bank accounts outside the UAE.

entry.title: IRS reminder: Permanent deduction for charitable gifts by non-itemizers starts with returns filed next year
entry.summary: IRS reminder: Permanent charitable contribution deduction begins for returns filed next year for taxpayers who do not itemize IRS · Nov 10, 2026 · GuidanceThe IRS reminded taxpayers who take the standard deduction that the Working Families Tax Cuts law makes permanent a deduction for charitable contributions starting in 2026. Eligible cash gifts to qualified charities can be deducted up to $1,000, or $2,000 for married couples filing jointly. Noncash gifts, contributions to supporting organizations, and donor advised funds do not qualify, and donors should keep records of their gifts.

entry.title: Man sentenced for fake £154m takeover bid targeting UK-listed company

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at the AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum 2026, "From Risk to Trust"
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Panel Chair’s Remarks at AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum 2026 SFC · Nov 9, 2026 · SpeechKelvin Wong, Chairman of the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong, delivered this speech at the AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum 2026 on regulation, judgment and responsibility. He argues that reliable financial reporting underpins investor confidence and Hong Kong's standing as an international financial centre. The speech stresses that preparers, boards, audit committees and auditors each have distinct responsibilities, and that regulation cannot replace professional scepticism.

entry.title: US Federal Register: 2027 Medicare and Medicaid Payment Policies Final Rule
entry.summary: Medicare and Medicaid Programs; CY 2027 Payment Policies Under the Physician Fee Schedule and Other Changes to Part B Payment and Coverage Policies; Medicare Shared Savings Program Requirements; and Medicare Prescription Drug Inflation Rebate Program Federal Register · Nov 9, 2026 · Rule · Effective Jan 1, 2027This final rule, published in the Federal Register, sets CY 2027 payment policies under the physician fee schedule and other Part B changes. entry.title: Final rule updating 2027 Home Health payment rates and related Medicare policies
entry.summary: Calendar Year 2027 Home Health Prospective Payment System (HH PPS) Rate Update; Requirements for the HH Quality Reporting Program and the Expanded HH Value-Based Purchasing Model; Medicare Provider Enrollment, Durable Medical Equipment (DME), and DME, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS) Policies Federal Register · Nov 9, 2026 · Rule · Effective Jan 4, 2026This final rule from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services updates Medicare home health payment rates for calendar year 2027 and recalibrates PDGM case-mix weights and low-utilization payment thresholds. It also revises the Home Health Quality Reporting Program and addresses face-to-face requirements for replacement DMEPOS items. The rule further covers provider enrollment, expanding the DME benefit to certain infusion pumps and drugs, and country-of-origin reporting for DMEPOS competitive bidding. entry.title: Withdrawal of Proposal to Lower Cross-Border Funds Transfer Information Threshold and Clarify Crypto Application
entry.summary: Threshold for the Requirement To Collect, Retain, and Transmit Information on Funds Transfers and Transmittals of Funds That Begin or End Outside the United States, and Clarification of the Requirement To Collect, Retain, and Transmit Information on Transactions Involving Convertible Virtual Currencies and Digital Assets With Legal Tender Status; Withdrawal Federal Register · Nov 9, 2026 · Draft / consultation · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Clarification of the Requirement To Collect, Retain, and Transmit Information on Transactions Involving Convertible Virtual Currencies and Digital Assets With Legal Tender Status」 FinCEN and the Federal Reserve Board are withdrawing a 2020 joint proposal that would have lowered the threshold for collecting and transmitting information on cross-border funds transfers from $3,000 to $250 and clarified that the rules apply to transactions involving convertible virtual currency and digital assets with legal tender status. The agencies cite the passage of more than five years since the proposal and significant recent developments in the crypto industry. Any future amendments would be considered in light of these changes and subject to further public comment. entry.title: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël CEO
entry.summary: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël Chief Executive Officer 05 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 5, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss Private Bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has announced the start of its operations in ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi, follo」 Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss private bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has started operations in ADGM after receiving a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA. The entity will advise institutions, corporates, fintechs, family offices and high net worth clients on accessing, holding, managing and passing on digital assets within ADGM's regulatory framework. Valérie Noël has been appointed Chief Executive Officer.

entry.title: FSRA warns public about suspected fraudulent scheme by Airo Capitals
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts the Public of Suspected Fraudulent Scheme by Airo Capitals ADGM / FSRA · Nov 5, 2026 · EnforcementThe Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM warns the public about a suspected fraudulent scheme by Airo Capitals. The entity falsely claims association with ADGM and FSRA regulation. The FSRA advises investors to verify firms through its Public Register and the ADGM Registration Authority's Public Register before dealing with them.
